text:
Logan Stankoven is 23, already a Stanley Cup winner from last spring, and off to the best scoring start of his career: 11 goals and 24 points in 25 games for Carolina. His own finishing is honest. He has 11 goals on 10.6 expected goals (the quality of his chances), and his 70 shots lead to the kind of looks that should keep coming.

The part to be careful with is everything around him. The Hurricanes have scored 9.6 more goals than their chances deserve with him on the ice, which is padding his assist total, and his 3.46 points per 60 sits well above our talent range (2.08 to 2.86). His last ten games show it: 12 points but only 2 goals, with ice time down about a minute and a half a night.

The process is still excellent. Carolina takes 64% of the expected goals with him on at five on five, and Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him 91st percentile at getting to the home-plate area last season. Our numbers say the points should slow a little; the player underneath is fine.
headline: Stankoven is good, and a little lucky too
